answer: We propose a protocol where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds calibrate staking collateral against a subgame-perfect punishment matrix to negate identity multiplication. Within this cryptoeconomic garden, an attacker managing an atlas of Sybil nodes faces slashing penalties that scale non-linearly with aggregate verifiable delay proof verification failures. This mechanism ensures that the pigment of adversarial utility remains strictly negative, compelling rational agents toward a unique Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates redundant entity creation.
